title: Area 6 Lockheed Martin aerial operations facility

tellings.quote: Area six, which is by the Yaka Mountain Flat, which has a Loheed Martin owned aerial operations facility

plain: A commentator who goes by the online name UAPGerb says, on Jesse Michels's podcast, that Area 6, a zone near Yucca Flat in the Nevada desert, holds an aerial operations facility owned by Lockheed Martin, a large American aerospace and defence company. He raises it while describing how the Pentagon's secret programme on unidentified craft is said to work, suggesting the site may play a part in it.
